SELF_AUDIT.zero_gc_check: No string.Format, File.AppendAllText, StreamWriter, new List, foreach, Pack=1, or DTO get/set properties were found in the SHINOBU_79 runtime static scan.

SELF_AUDIT.aup_check: Route targets and current position stay double3. Steering subtracts current from target before casting the local delta to float3. Telemetry stores local millimeters and sector hashes. Optional KCC output subtracts intended vault.CurrentAUP from BodyAup before float math, records the worst of actual position delta and float reconstruction error, and flags >1mm. A separate last-AUP audit subtracts previous double3 before casting and flags >500m local jumps unless the current frame carries MockRebaseSignal.
SELF_AUDIT.scalability_curve: GlobalQualityWeight is forced on a Stopwatch-measured wall-clock 600s loop: 300s at 0.1, 60s smoothstep recovery to 1.0, then full-quality dwell. CSV records the forced value for regression proof. SHI stress uses the same Stopwatch wall clock, not frame count or fast-forwarded simulation duration. BotNavigationJob consumes the same weight: below 0.3, math.step bypasses the rich SDF normal and uses one analytic approximation; above 0.3, polynomial smoothstep blends back into the high-quality SDF gradient.
SELF_AUDIT.hphi_vault_status: Persistent data is requested through VaultBufferHandle IDs 70580..70594 plus BufferID.ShinobuInputCurrentDto; no persistent private NativeArray allocations are owned by the MonoBehaviour.

SELF_AUDIT.false_sharing: Shinobu38WatchdogTelemetryEntry is 64B. FileWriterStateDTO, FileWriterCursorDTO, and WaypointIngestStateDTO are 128B, separating producer/consumer counters across cache-line-sized padded records.
SELF_AUDIT.dependency_graph: Runtime assembly remains in QA Headless and references Core.Contracts, Core, Core.Memory, Unity.Burst, Unity.Collections, and Unity.Mathematics only. Hecton8.Physics resolves from the Core assembly because no asmdef exists at Assets/_Project/Scripts/Physics root; no sibling Physics runtime asmdef reference was added.
SELF_AUDIT.time_source: Simulation state uses FastTick delta. Wall-clock stress uses Stopwatch.GetTimestamp() deltas clamped to 1s per sample, so editor manual stepping cannot compress the five-minute quality soak. Time.frameCount is used only as the required handshake frame for InputDispatcher.ApplyAutomationOverride, whose consumer also uses Time.frameCount; it is not used to integrate watchdog movement, memory windows, quality soak, or SHI pulse duration.
SELF_AUDIT.dear_lie: Terrain avoidance is a trigonometric SDF cave probe, not NavMesh or Physics.Raycast. A real pathfinding/broadphase approach would scale with scene/query complexity and collider count; this watchdog uses O(1) direct mathematical samples per frame. At low quality, avoidance is one distance sample plus analytic normal. At high quality, it is still O(1) but pays a bounded rich normal path instead of a scene query.
